INTRODUCING THE PUFFCO PROXY PIPE :
FOR HASH AND WAX LOVERS:
The Puffco ProxyTM is a portable, modular vaporizer that takes your cannabis consumption to another level. This revolutionary vaporizer pairs the best of Puffco Peak Pro and the Puffco Budsy into one.
The Proxy simplifies discovering the wonders of hash with its single-button interface and 3D Chamber. Additionally, the Proxy Collection offers an array of pieces and accessories to further expand your hash experience. The Proxy is also created to evolve with you.
PUFFCO PROXY PIPE FEATURES:
For Concentrate, Hash & Dry herbs ( Flower Bowl sold separately )
Modular Attachable to Different Glassware
30-second heat-up time
Available in Black and Desert colourways
Includes Borosilicate Glass Pipe
90-minute recharge
LED light feedback
Auto-sleep function
Easy to clean
PROXY MODULAR DESIGN:
The Proxy Pipe vaporizer features a 3D Chamber bowl on top of the base that keeps the flavor pure and provides fast heat-up.
Modular means that included parts can be picked apart, and the Proxy base unit can be inserted and used with different glassware.
The bowl is also replaceable for dry herb consumption with the Proxy Flower Bowl ( sold separately ), making the Proxy a unique, futuristic, portable dual modular vaporizer. The included Glass Pipe has a familiar design, but with this modular design, literary “everything’s a pipe”.
PROXY 3D CHAMBER
The high-tech heating technology 3D Chamber gives a premium vapor quality as expected from Puffco.
The 3D name comes from the heating element located at the chamber wall from all sides rather than the bottom.
This setup of the heating tracers is the main difference from other chambers on the market. Puffco is making sure you get the best flavour and evenly heated oil in each puff.
VERY PORTABLE CONCENTRATE HASH PIPE:
The Puffco Proxy is a compact vaporizer and the ideal device for vaping enthusiasts who are on the go. This pocket-sized device is as powerful as it is discreet and offers vapers a convenient way to enjoy their favourite flavours without having to worry about bulky equipment.
The Puffco Proxy comes with a sturdy carrying case that is designed to protect your device from bumps and scratches. The case also features a secure closure for added convenience.
BATTERY LIFE EXPERIENCE:
The Proxy has an average battery lifespan of 13 to 15 cycles. The number of cycles will be contingent on the temperature setting chosen. Impressive battery life considering the size of this dab tool. With Puffco products, pass-through charging comes as a standard feature. This allows you to use your device while it is being charged; however, with safety in mind, it is always advised to be prepared with a USB-C battery bank with an output of 2.4 amps as a backup in case you are on the go.
THERE IS A HEAT SETTING SUITABLE FOR EVERYONE.
Blue (Low) – Most flavor, lowest vapor production Green (Medium) – Balanced flavor and vapor Red (High) – High vapor with good flavor White (Peak) – Highest vapor, for bigger dabs.
The 3D heating element, paired with precise temperature control, helps prevent the extract from being vaporized before extraction. This system yields consistent and flavorful vapor.
PROXY VAPOR QUALITY:
Vapor flavor quality is something that Puffco has taken into consideration when designing their line of vapes. The company understands that vaping is an experience and not just a way to consume cannabis, so they have made sure to create products that give the user the best possible vaping experience. The Proxy is no exception, it’s designed to ensure vapor quality with a creamy and flavorful taste. It has a larger mouthpiece than most vape pens, allowing the vapor to cool before inhalation and dissipating heat into the air rather than the user’s face.
Puffco has modernized the design of traditional pipes, which have used this style for a long time and been established as successful. This pipe design is not new but it has been improved on by Puffco. The result is so much better than we expected, you need to try to know.
Pro Tip
: We tried all heat modes and got the most flavorful vapor using the Blue setting.
THE PROXY COLLECTION – THE BEST ADD-ON ACCESSORIES:
The Proxy consists of three parts: the base unit, the atomizer, and the battery cap. This gives users unparalleled control over their dabbing experience, allowing them to customize the experience. With its modular design, we have seen a glass artist competition and new ways of dabbing with the Proxy on Puffcos Instagram.
THE DROPLET
The Proxy Droplet is a new bubbler specifically designed for water filtration. The base of the Droplet is designed to optimize performance, with a distinct rumble on smoother hits. It is crafted with a hand-blown borosilicate glass that has an ocean blue drop inside a gradient-frosted clear body for a pleasing aesthetic look. This product incorporates both form and function. It is comfortable to hold and can be placed on any flat surface in your home.
THE BUB
The Proxy Bub also enables water functionality for the Proxy experience. The water filtration process results in a smoother and cooler draw. This product is crafted from hand-blown borosilicate glass and has a flat base. It looks and feels like a unicorn horn from the future.
THE TRAVEL PIPE
The Proxy Travel Pipe is a shatter-proof, silicone body pipe accessory designed to be easily portable. It contains a storage pocket that can fit two tools or any other object one wishes to transport with them. The Proxy Travel Pipe is suitable for any environment, whether you are traveling through rugged terrain or urban areas.
THE TRAVEL PACK
The Proxy Travel Pack makes it easy to organize everything needed to consume into one portable container. making it easier than ever to consume on the go.
THE FLOWER BOWL
The Proxy flower bowl enables you to use any Proxy glass piece or accessory with the flower. It has a quick plug-in airtight seal for secure attachment. This small and simple piece eliminates the need to carry a special flower pipe.
THE HOT KNIFE
The Puffco Hot Knife is an electronic loading tool with a heated blade. This dual tool enables easy, clean, and efficient concentrate handling. The use of dab tools eliminates the mess of sticky residue on clothing, surfaces, and supplements with wiping concentrates on the bowl. By pressing the button, the oil can be removed within 3 seconds. Perfect for loading your Puffco Proxy ceramic bowl.
HOW TO USE THE PUFFCO PROXY?
Using the Puffco Proxy is straightforward:
Charge your device before using it, The Proxy takes about 90 min to charge.
Hold down the button on the side for 3 seconds to turn on your device
The Proxy features 4 heat settings: BLUE ( Lowest Temp ), GREEN, RED, and WHITE ( Hottest Temp ).
Simply “Single” click on the button to switch between heat settings.
Open the carb cap and cold load your Proxy before heating up ( don’t overpack the chamber ).
Press back the carb cap on top of the chamber.
“Double” click to start the heat up ( LED light pulsating in selected heat setting )
After about 30 seconds, the Proxy LED will flash, and the device will vibrate.
Hold the device upright and vertically during use and inhale.
“Double” click on the Proxy to re-heat for another inhale. ( Recommended not to re-heat more than 4 times )
CLEANING:
Make sure to clean your chamber after usage to remove any oil residue. This is best done with a Q-tip and some ISO alcohol.
LIMITED WARRANTY.
The Proxy is covered by a Puffco Limited Warranty Period, beginning on the purchase date and lasting 1 year. Claims must be made to customer service within the specified time frame to be valid. Customers should be aware that 3D chambers are consumable components with an anticipated lifespan and warranty cover of between 1-3 months, depending on use. They should furthermore be regularly cleaned to ensure optimal performance.
Order Puffco Proxy Near Me
FINAL SUMMARY OF PUFFCO PROXY.
The Puffco Proxy is a revolutionary concentrate device and Puffco has set the benchmark since the release of the original Peak. It offers an innovative design and could have far-reaching effects on cannabis culture due to its potential.
The Proxy — in its original form — is an electronic device designed for smoking hash, similar to smoking cannabis. It allows users to smoke without restrictions on time and location.
Initially, we were worried that a lack of water would result in an unpleasant smoking experience, however, our Proxy hit was smooth and flavorful, efficient vapor. We did not find it necessary to use water and instead appreciated the concentrate smoking experience. Experience the bold taste of the vaporizer unlike anything you’ve ever had before – it’s not your everyday ceremonial bong! Feel the enthralling vibe of the Puffco Peak or Peak Pro, perfectly designed for at-home indulgence.

Puffco follows a comprehensive design process that results in products that become cultural references rather than waste. Their latest creation, the Proxy, is one of their most successful ones to date, and we look forward to seeing what they come up with next!
